title: Generative Online Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2512.02581v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) faces a persistent tension: policies that are stable to optimize (e.g., Gaussians) are often too simple to represent the multimodal action distributions required for complex control. Conversely, expressive generative policies---such as diffusion and flow matching---can be difficult to optimize in online RL due to intractable likelihoods and gradients propagating through long sampling chains. We address this tension with a key structural principle: decoupling optimization from generation. Building on this, we introduce GoRL (Generative Online Reinforcement Learning), an algorithm-agnostic framework that trains expressive policies from scratch by confining policy optimization to a tractable latent space while delegating action synthesis to a conditional generative decoder. translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）面临着一个持久的矛盾：易于稳定优化的策略（例如高斯策略）往往过于简单，无法表示复杂控制所要求的多模态动作分布；相反，具有强表达能力的生成式策略——如扩散模型和流匹配——由于似然难以求解、且梯度需要穿过漫长的采样链进行传播，在在线强化学习中难以优化。我们用一个关键的结构性原则来解决这一矛盾：将优化与生成分离（解耦）。基于这一原则，我们提出了GoRL（生成式在线强化学习），这是一个与具体算法无关的框架，它通过将策略优化限制在易于处理的潜空间中，同时把动作合成委托给条件生成解码器，从而从头训练具有强表达能力的策略。借助双时间尺度的交替训练调度，并将解码器的改进锚定在固定先验上，GoRL能够在实现稳定优化的同时……（原文在此截断）
tldr: GoRL通过“优化与生成分离”的结构性原则——在易处理的潜空间中进行策略优化，而由条件生成解码器负责动作合成——实现了在在线强化学习中从头训练既稳定又具强表达能力的生成式策略。
en_tdlr: GoRL decouples optimization from generation by confining policy optimization to a tractable latent space while delegating action synthesis to a conditional generative decoder, enabling stable training of expressive generative policies from scratch in online RL.
